_provenance.note: TroveManager carrying Liquity's Recovery-Mode multi-liquidation correction: both loops subtract the gas compensation and the borrower's surplus from the running system collateral. Test-only fixture for the fork-based SIP tests; the production implementation is deployed from zero-contracts and saved as the TroveManagerLiquidationFix record / PERIMETER_ZERO_TROVE_MANAGER env. Constructor takes (BOOTSTRAP_PERIOD, permit2) and both are immutable, so it must be built with the live proxy's values.
